segments.text: Mahindra just got caught testing the new Thar — and it's wearing the Roxx's face.
The 2026 facelift, spied: flush LED headlamps, C-shaped DRLs, body-colour grille, 19-inch alloys. Inside — a 10.25-inch screen, and Level 2 ADAS is reportedly coming.
Today's Thar still packs the punch: 2.0-litre turbo-petrol, 152 PS, 320 Nm, proper 4x4.
Prices run ₹10.32 to ₹17.80 lakh. Smart money's on the LXT RWD Diesel, around ₹12.99 lakh — big screen, cruise, keyless — without the 4x4 premium.
Everyone buys the Thar for the mountains. The only summit most will ever see is the mall parking ramp — twice on Sundays.
The facelift lands festive 2026. Grab today's deal, or wait for the Roxx face? Fight it out in the comments.
